project_title: Anpabelt Trah Javala - Personal Digital Home & Editorial Blog

persona_and_owner.name: Anpabelt Trah Javala
persona_and_owner.tone_of_voice: Playful, first-person, curious, intellectually honest, personal, non-corporate

design_archetype.name: Editorial Dark Retro-Cosmic
design_archetype.description: Refined dark retro/space identity combining a deep obsidian-emerald canvas with glowing teal/emerald accents, sculptural display typography, and a quiet, tactile editorial layout for long-form reading.

display_font.usage: Main H1-H3 headings, hero phrases, section tags, big numbers

body_font.usage: UI body text, navigation, meta tags, project summaries, form fields

editorial_serif.usage: Blog long-form article body paragraphs, blockquotes, author bio callouts

monospace_font.usage: Code snippets, terminal blocks, tech stack tags, stats, dates, administrative IDs

starfield_and_cosmic_motif.concept: Subtle, atmospheric retro-space motif providing depth without distracting from content or execution speed.
implementation_rules: Use lightweight HTML5 Canvas or SVG particle background with reduced point count (30-50 stars max).
Stars should twinkle softly with smooth opacity cycling (0.1 to 0.7) rather than harsh flashes.
Include periodic, rare shooting star animation (every 12-18 seconds, 0.8s duration) across top viewport.
Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion' by pausing particle movement and freezing opacity.
Never block pointer events (pointer-events: none on canvas overlay).
Provide smooth radial gradient vignette at viewport edges to anchor editorial text.

bento_and_grids.experience_timeline: space-y-8 border-l border-zinc-800/80 pl-6 sm:pl-8 ml-2 sm:ml-4
bento_and_grids.blog_listing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 border-b border-zinc-800/60 pb-12

navigation_header.style: Floating crystal glass capsule navbar centered at viewport top
navigation_header.classes: fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0d1510]/80 border border-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-3 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300
navigation_header.cta: Admin Login / Dashboard button with subtle teal stroke

hero_section.structure: Asymmetrical text-dominant layout with oversized Lexend Giga title, playful first-person intro bio, student tag ('UTP Malaysia'), interactive availability status badge, and dual CTAs ('Read Blog', 'Explore Projects').
hero_section.status_badge: Live pulsing emerald dot + 'Crafting software @ UTP, Malaysia'

project_cards.style: Dark elevated cards with subtle 1px border, smooth lift on hover, image preview with gradient overlay, tags in monospace pill badges, live demo and GitHub source links.
project_cards.border: border border-white/5 hover:border-teal-500/30 transition-all duration-300 shadow-xl

blog_editorial.listing_style: High-density editorial index with publication dates, reading time badges, tags, clean excerpts, and featured cover image thumbnails.

article_reading_experience.header: Large dramatic Lexend Giga title, published date, tag pills, author avatar + bio snippet, estimated reading time.
article_reading_experience.typography: Newsreader/serif font for long-form prose, large initial drop-cap on first paragraph, custom styled blockquotes with teal vertical border, syntax-highlighted code blocks with copy-to-clipboard button.
article_reading_experience.navigation: Sticky subtle progress bar at top, back to blog link, next/previous post links at footer.

admin_cms_dashboard.style: High-clarity, dark tactical admin interface for managing blog articles and media.
features: Login screen with password protection & secure state
Post list view with Status tabs (All, Published, Drafts)
Post Editor with split or full markdown preview, cover image upload dropzone, slug generator, tag input, draft/publish controls
Image gallery manager to browse uploaded assets and copy markdown URLs

forms_and_contact.style: Tactile dark input fields with teal focus rings, clear validation states, accessible labels, interactive submit button with loading state, and Sonner toast notifications upon success.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, nav links, blog cards, and CMS controls MUST include unambiguous kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="nav-blog-link", data-testid="admin-publish-button").
testing_and_accessibility.wcag_compliance: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for body text against dark green-black background (#0d1510) and 3:1 for large display titles and interactive indicators.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-teal-400 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0d1510]) on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Structure the application cleanly with full Astro/React pages or dynamic components for Home, About, Projects, Contact, Blog Listing, Blog Post, and Admin CMS.
Inject Google Fonts for Lexend Giga, DM Sans, Newsreader, and JetBrains Mono in head.
Implement the background Canvas starfield with smooth twinkle, gentle drift, and shooting stars without impacting scroll performance.
Maintain the first-person playful voice of Anpabelt Trah Javala throughout the website copy and sample blog articles.
Build a robust SQLite or LocalStorage/API backed CMS under /admin allowing CRUD operations on blog posts with cover image preview and status toggles.
Use Sonner for toasts on contact submission, admin actions, and image URL copies.
Add data-testid to every button, link, input, post card, and CMS action button.
